target: obs.sh context clear — phase_end marker, then untagged events
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic; printf '%s' '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" context set --phase review --spec-id s.md; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" context clear; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" emit probe '{}'; cat .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl | jq -cs '{end: (map(select(.event=="phase_end")) | first), probe: (map(select(.event=="probe")) | first), ctx_gone: true}'
